notes.title: Nerial's new experimental Reality TV game is available now!
notes.content:
[h3]It's the pilot episode of 1999's hottest reality TV show, The Crush House! [/h3]

Cast, film, and produce the show for maximum drama while balancing what the audience wants to see and what the talent needs from you. If you don't get CANCELLED, you might even discover the secrets behind the house's plastic veneer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/b2f5074f8b2be54d518bf42e76ba54fb67ec909f.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/5b65480a11a7c5723ccb9f2bb8314b6d21e552f9.gif[/img]

have tried to make something experimentally silly and still fun. We think that The Crush House is unlike anything we've made before and any other game. You may find that the procedural dialogue system and the need to balance audience thirsts is Reigns-esque. Since this is live television, you'll find lots of product placement from familiar games. 

It has been a long journey since the first Reigns game 8 years ago, and we want to thank you for being a part of it! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337820/The_Crush_House/

notes.title: Blast off with a new Reigns game coming to Steam
notes.content:
[h1]Get ready to rock and roll through space, Reigns Beyond is coming to Steam this spring![/h1]

Set a course to stardom in this sci-fi spin on the novel card-swiping game. You join an intergalactic indie rock band travelling to distant planets to host gigs of various sizes, all for fame and fortune. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663400/Reigns_Beyond/

Recruit alien band members, visit new places, manage your ship's resources and keep your crew happy while you cruise through the galaxy.

Oh and keep an eye out for some sharp-toothed "friends"...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/a01c44a64aa977c11873da081afd843eb6202685.gif[/img]

Weirder human and alien encounters, even weirder deaths, and exciting new gameplay that features the ever-amazing original soundtrack by Sam Webster. With 70 new characters and over 1700 cards, this is not the same Reigns royal courts you may be familiar with.

[previewyoutube=v3sMQgPG3Xc;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772779/df531a043f76c752083222e4b9d9cdf77eafaacd.png[/img]
Eager to play already? You can still play the mobile version exclusively on Apple Arcade

notes.title: New Reigns Game has launched on Steam
notes.content:
[h1]Reigns: Three Kingdoms has launched on Steam![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2437040/Reigns_Three_Kingdoms/

Jump back in time to ancient China. You arrive during the end years of the Han Dynasty, inspired by the tales of [i]The Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/i], you will come across a wide cast of notable characters; will you form alliances or rivalries? Journey through epic quests across the 13 regions and make choices that will ripple throughout your adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/5595906b9ca4bb02430a06f7f58e0da5593191cd.gif[/img]
[h3]Newest Feature: Card Battles[/h3]
A brand new twist to the Reignsverse; a card-swiping turn-based battle system. Throughout your journey, you'll come across opportunities to battle opponents using a draft of the characters you [strike][i]collect[/i][/strike] recruit on the way. This fresh spin allows you to use the classic swiping mechanic to execute your attacks, so you must plan your strategy to be victorious!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/c0503c577a804224455d2266dd59ec38f9a99767.gif[/img]
[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
Along with the combat, we have added multiplayer to the series; battle your friends or strangers online and work your way up the leaderboard. This feature is also crossplay; you can battle against players on Switch and Mobile

[h3]Complete the set[/h3]
Whether you have one or all of the Reigns titles, we have collected all the ones on Steam into one epic bundle, allowing you to complete your Reigns series and save some money

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37837/Reigns_Complete_Set/

notes.title: New Reigns Game is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Reigns: Three Kingdoms is coming to Steam on January 11th![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2437040/Reigns_Three_Kingdoms/

The latest addition to the Reignsverse is the most tantalising one yet. Inspired by the beloved epic, [i]The Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/i], you'll take on the challenges found in the heart of the Han Dynasty. It’ll be up to you to unite the 13 regions and forge a path through decisive decision-making.

With unique characters, storylines, and quests to discover; this retelling of the stories found in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms will immerse you in diplomacy and military tactics with legendary characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772779/f2b93dcd8065ac86b3f17f89eb199c7cc3df2c5b.gif[/img]

The newest feature of the series is the card battle system. These battles incorporate the unique card-swiping mechanic, used throughout the Reignsverse, creating a new and effective way to add a fresh spin to the series. The characters you encounter will join your party and can be included in your drafts for each battle, you will also be able to challenge friends online!

[previewyoutube=jpYqrQoQm-M;full][/previewyoutube]

Eager to play already? You can still play the mobile version on Netflix!

notes.title: New Reigns Game is available NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Reigns: Three Kingdoms is available NOW! [/h2]

[url=https://www.netflix.com/game/81569952][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/f2b93dcd8065ac86b3f17f89eb199c7cc3df2c5b.gif[/img][/url]

This new instalment in the Reigns series is undoubtedly our most ambitious one yet. Based on the beloved epic, [i]The Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/i], you'll take on the challenge of uniting 13 regions of the Han Dynasty, one decision at a time. 

Each region contains unique characters, storylines and quests where you'll use diplomacy, courtship and military strength to become its leader. Each of these plots are adapted from the web of stories found in [i]The Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/i] which means you'll meet many legendary characters along the way. 

Those characters will join your party in the card battle system. It was a challenge to build engaging battles with only two inputs, left and right, but we believe we have done it. You can even draft your deck to challenge friends online or test your wits to climb the ranked leaderboard. 

Reigns: Three Kingdoms is [url=https://www.netflix.com/game/81569952]AVAILABLE NOW[/url] on Android and iOS exclusively for Netflix subscribers. 

[previewyoutube=RszwKQNIyD4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New game from the creators of Reigns!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=hQlknqTFcko;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Card Shark is now available for everyone to play! [/h3]

[i]We have brought together all sorts of ruffians, scoundrels and hooligans because a great opportunity has reached our midst. In Card Shark, you'll take the least ethical path to achieve wealth, fame and status by cheating your way up the aristocracy. 

But that path is also a dangerous one. The risks you take can leave you in worse shape than your humble beginnings or even take your life if you are not careful. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/a6e51aef9808c247e11662e5648f3dd7de4ddaa4.gif[/img]

From all of us at Nerial, we want to thank you sincerely for joining us on this journey to launch. Making a game is like manipulating a deck. Managing and fine-tuning each step to bring wonder out of what appears to be random chance. 

We believe we have created a unique and artful experience. To be completely honest, this isn't the type of game that typically performs very well on Steam. However, if you do enjoy our game, we hope that you'll leave a positive review! It really helps us continue to make games that reimagine real life in surprising ways. 

So as you start this new adventure of delectable deceit, we hope you will have fun, learn something new and cheat your opponents' pockets dry. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/6a21bdc807646c3ff535bdc29b81f2784d9ceb87.gif[/img]

We have many Card Shark fans on our other platforms! Please join us there

notes.title: Our next game is launching June 2!
notes.content:
[h3]Our next game, Card Shark, is launching on June 2! [/h3]

[previewyoutube=6ARLZYZvKm0;full][/previewyoutube]

Firstly, we want to thank you for playing and supporting the Reigns series. What started as a relatively simple idea, a Game of Thrones story with Tinder gameplay, has grown into something that our team would never have imagined all those years ago. We've brought Reigns to the outer space, the board game table, and even to Westeros thanks to players like you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/75815e71c93cb61aad1e4121b6b113d669ab1957.gif[/img]

Our next game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371720/Card_Shark/]Card Shark[/url], is our most ambitious project so far. We've put years of love and craft into this game to make it stand out. You'll uncover a thrilling historical conspiracy in 18th century France by cheating at gambling salons, aristocratic abodes, and the King's table. You'll meet some of the most influential figures of the era like Voltaire and Louis XV along with historical tricksters and scammers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/6a21bdc807646c3ff535bdc29b81f2784d9ceb87.gif[/img]

Nicolai Troshinsky created the eye-catching art style through monoprinting, an illustration technique where painted layers are added on top of each other to form a complete image. Andrea Boccadoro has brought his experience scoring for film and TV to a period-accurate score that includes original pieces and reimaginings of existing scores. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/a6e51aef9808c247e11662e5648f3dd7de4ddaa4.gif[/img]

All the cheating techniques are real tricks that cheaters and magicians use in our world. The sleight of hand, deck switching, and card marking have been faithfully created. 

If you'd like to see if the game is for you, you can try the Demo on Steam or Nintendo Switch right now! 

[h3]Pre-order Card Shark now at 15% off![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371720/Card_Shark/

notes.title: Demo the new game from the creators of Reigns!
notes.content:
[h3]Devious deeds are afoot at the gambling tables! [/h3]

Attention Nobles!

We’ve received word that a few of your guests may not be playing fair. 

The enigmatic [i]Comte de St. Germain[/i] and his quiet apprentice have been winning generous sums across France. What’s more is that the [i]Comte[/i] is investigating a mystery that goes as high as the King, Louis XV. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371720/Card_Shark/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/2a9f3bba4a92deb1bca579c70c77b4f4fae24f57.gif[/img][/url]

They have perfected their techniques so the cheating goes unnoticed. However, I’ve heard that they can use sleight of hand, card marking, and secret signals to stack the deck in their favor. 

If you keep one eye on the cards and the other over your shoulder, you might have the wits to catch them in the act. 

There are few crimes lower than dishonesty at the table. If you catch them, I expect they'll receive severe punishment. 

[url=discord.gg/nerial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/73c7a18308c7325b24480073306d7959e0dc3926.jpg[/img][/url]

I imagine you'd like to learn more about their nefarious schemes. Please join us at our new Discord Server; the best place for Card Shark info.  

With this knowledge, I will trust these cards in your hands. 

[i]Jared & the Nerial Team[/i]

notes.title: Discord Server with the Reigns team!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings nobles![/h3]

You are cordially invited to the launch of our new Discord Server. 

[b]Your invite link: [url=https://discord.gg/nerial]https://discord.gg/nerial[/url][/b]

Our development team began as a few people making a simple card game. Thanks to all of you, [i]Reigns[/i] has expanded to the board game table, Westeros and Beyond.

We want to spend more time communicating with our players, which is where I come in! I'm Jared, Nerial's Community Manager and newest member. 

The Nerial Discord Server will be a place where you can tell stories from your playthroughs, ask questions to our dev team, but most of all, celebrate games that share meaningful stories in surprising ways. 

We are just one of many studios that have similar goals. We want to make and play games that explore new ideas. If you enjoyed Reigns or if you're interested in our upcoming game, [i][url=https://bit.ly/33bjUmg]Card Shark[/url][/i], then we are probably quite alike! 

Head over to our Server because we can't wait to hear about the games you love.

[i]Jared & the Nerial team[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.22
notes.content:
This update should solve the corrupt data bug. If that happened to you, try pressing "r" for 5 sec to reset the game. If it doesnt work, try to locate the local game files and delete them (generally in C:\Users\<user_name>\AppData\LocalLow\devolver\reigns or Users/username/library/cache/devolver/reigns on Mac ). The bug happened when the game was not closing properly, creating faulty game save and unfortunately, I can't retrieve them. Try to press "esc" and use the "quit" button to save your progress. 

If you still have the problem, it may be because the game can't write in the local game file (the dir described up there).

This update is also an attempt at solving some of the crashes encountered at start. Still looking into some of these. Feel free to ask for refund if it doesn't work for you. 

And also, a great big thanks for your support and your interest in the game. We want to do more Reigns! http://nerial.co.uk/reigns/#more
